text:
Alex: Quick check — I'm splitting the storage terraform module into storage-core + storage-cloud and hoisting provider blocks. PR here: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/4523. When I run plan in staging the lockfile complains about mixed provider pins. Can we coordinate a small canary + lockfile update? cc @Maria @Raj
Maria: I can take a look. Can you paste the exact plan error?
Alex: sure — here's the relevant bit:
```
Error: Inconsistent provider versions
  on providers.tf line 4, in terraform:
  4: required_providers {
    provider["registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/google"] = { version = "~> 4.0" }
  }

The root module is requesting providers with different version constraints than the lockfile. Run `terraform init` or regenerate the lockfile.
```
Raj: sounds like the module split changed provider constraints. Suggested flow: 1) state mv resources that move into storage-cloud to the new module path in a staging workspace, 2) run `terraform init` then `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64`, 3) commit updated .terraform.lock.hcl, 4) apply canary in staging-canary workspace with a very small target.
Taylor: heads-up — storage-cloud will change k8s secret names (we rename sa token secret). Helm chart in charts/storage needs `saSecretName` updated or pods will fail during rollout. I can update the chart once lockfile/plan is stable.
Jen: I'll review the PR once you push the lockfile change, aim for <30m. If we need a fast rollback path, add a canary tag and a forced fallback to storage-core.
ops-bot: Deploybot: canary workspace `staging-canary` created by Alex at 1738765460.
Alex: running `terraform init` now with `-reconfigure` then `terraform providers lock`. Posting results in a sec.
Maria: if you still see version mismatches try `terraform init -upgrade` first — sometimes it refreshes provider checksums and clears the lock mismatch.
Alex: did `init -reconfigure` -> still complained, then `init -upgrade` -> providers lock regenerated successfully and I committed `.terraform.lock.hcl`. Ran plan in staging-canary -> no diffs for global infra, small target apply succeeded.
Raj: nice. After you merge, let's schedule a short rollout window for prod and make sure SRE watches the pod restarts.
Taylor: chart updated in a separate PR, I'll link after tests.
Jen: LGTM on the approach, leave a note in the PR description about the lockfile regen steps for on-call.
Alex: merged lockfile + module split PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/4523 — canary passed, chart update incoming. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Maria: great job. Reminder for post-merge: run `terraform providers mirror` on CI to cache providers for the dedicated build runners.
Alex: noted — adding to the PR checklist.
ops-bot: Deploybot: canary apply finished at 1738765485, status: SUCCESS.
